option_relations.rationale: Acute pancreatitis and renal failure are distinct conditions from congestive heart failure with liver disease, although some overlap in clinical signs or secondary effects might exist.
Gallbladder mucocele and pancreatitis are distinct conditions from congestive heart failure with liver disease, though liver involvement can be seen in severe cases of gallbladder disease.
Chronic kidney disease is a distinct condition from congestive heart failure with liver disease.
Pancreatitis is a distinct condition from congestive heart failure with liver disease.
